title: Boundless
description: Seamless streaming engine for giant multi-level worlds (500×500 to 6000×6000+ cells) in Foundry VTT v14: Quadtree pyramid with Web Worker decoding, shadowed GPU light batching, chunked fog of war, POI fast-travel, native layer streaming, and client-side Lazy TokenLayer.

recommends.reason: Boosts canvas FPS with token UI batching, HUD/effect caching, lighting render scaling, and precomputed light noise shaders.
